description: Dispatcher unknown-type failure scenario: CalculateMovingAverage called with an unsupported maType. Three sub-cases: (1) maType=WMA (Weighted MA — not implemented); (2) maType=VWMA (Volume-Weighted — not implemented); (3) maType='' (empty string). All must return ErrUnknownMAType and nil output. Verifies the dispatcher rejects anything other than SMA/sma/EMA/ema.

expectedOutput.error: moving_average: unknown maType: must be SMA or EMA
expectedOutput.note: All three cases MUST return ErrUnknownMAType. Output MUST be nil. Case-insensitive matching applies only for SMA/EMA — any other string is rejected regardless of casing.
